BrochureContent.Content:
Fenelon Properties are excited to bring No. 7 King Edward Park to the market, a substantial four-bedroom detached residence occupying an impressive mature site in this highly regarded and premium residential area of Bray.
Built in approximately 1972 and extending to circa 205 sq.m, No. 7 is a spacious and well-maintained family home offering generous proportions, excellent living accommodation and considerable outdoor space. Set on approximately 0.25 acres, the property enjoys mature gardens, extensive off-street parking and the added benefit of a detached garage.
King Edward Park is a quiet, mature development situated off King Edward Road, within easy walking distance of Bray Town Centre. Properties of this size, on sites of this scale and in such a convenient central location are increasingly difficult to find.
The property is approached through a gated entrance onto a generous driveway providing ample off-street parking. There is further parking to the side of the property through wide side gates. The front garden is bordered by mature hedging and established planting, giving the house a pleasant degree of privacy from the road.
Internally, the accommodation is bright, spacious and well laid out. An enclosed entrance porch opens into a welcoming hallway with substantial understairs storage. To the right is a large sitting room overlooking the front garden and featuring an open fireplace. This connects with the dining room, which in turn opens into the sunroom, creating a particularly generous sequence of living and entertaining spaces.
The kitchen has been recently fitted (2022) and provides an excellent range of contemporary units, worktop space and storage, with direct access to the garden. A separate study provides a useful home office, while a combined utility room/WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.
At first-floor level there are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a particularly spacious principal bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en-suite bathroom. A family bathroom and landing with access to the attic complete the accommodation.
One of the outstanding features of No. 7 is its exceptionally generous garden. The property stands on a fan-shaped site extending to approximately 0.25 acres, with extensive lawns complemented by mature trees, hedging, shrubs and established planting.
A paved patio immediately adjoining the house provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while the extensive lawn offers excellent space for children, gardening and recreation.
Vehicular access runs along the side of the house to a detached garage/workshop, which is wired for electricity and benefits from a fitted sink, providing excellent additional storage and workspace. There is also a separate block-built garden shed to the rear, also wired for electricity and ideal for the storage of garden tools, equipment and other household items.
The property further benefits from generous off-street parking to the front and wide side access to the rear garden.
King Edward Park is a well-established residential development in an exceptionally convenient Bray location. No. 7 is approximately 500 metres from Bray Town Centre, placing shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities within easy walking distance.
A wide selection of primary and secondary schools are available locally, together with Bray Institute of Further Education. Bray's seafront, promenade and harbour are also within easy reach, while the surrounding area offers an excellent choice of sporting and recreational facilities including golf, tennis, GAA, football, sailing and coastal walks.
Transport connections are excellent, with Bray DART station and numerous Dublin Bus services providing access to Dublin City Centre. The N11/M11 and M50 road networks are readily accessible, while the Luas at Cherrywood provides a further transport option.
No. 7 King Edward Park offers a rare combination of substantial accommodation, a large mature garden and a highly convenient location close to the centre of Bray. With approximately 205 sq.m of living space, four generous bedrooms and a detached garage, this is an excellent opportunity to acquire a long-term family home in one of Bray's most established residential settings.
